conventions.result: 'pass' | 'fail' (lower-cased Result column); resultVerbatim is the Result cell exactly as printed. Every report prints only 'Pass' or 'Fail'; 'not applicable' never appears — N/A-style rows print 'Pass' with the evaluation text 'Pass due to no corresponding content'.
conventions.techniques: Technique/failure ids from the evaluation row, in report order, nested sub-techniques flattened, duplicates removed. Advisory techniques with an id are listed separately in advisoryTechniques; advisory "Future Link" entries have no id and are omitted.
conventions.quote: Fail rows: the evaluation row verbatim, list items joined with ' | ' (failure-technique titles included). Pass rows: only the free-text part of the evaluation row (e.g. 'Pass due to no corresponding content'), else null.
conventions.elements: Present only on keyboard/AT criteria (1.1.1, 1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 3.2.1, 4.1.2). Array of {selector, snippet, technique, basis}, or the string 'not specific enough'. Every selector was checked in headless Chromium to match exactly one element; snippet is that element's outerHTML (whitespace-collapsed, cut at 180 chars). notSpecificEnough lists cited failures that could not be pinned to elements.
